tagline: Lost for words? We've got you.

onboarding.heading: Your HR support, in your pocket
onboarding.text: Templates, guides and tools to help you run great 1:1s and handle tricky conversations with confidence.

onboarding.heading: Nothing is stored
onboarding.text: SayWotNow never saves what you type. When you're done, your notes are emailed from your own mail app, and the form is cleared.

onboarding.heading: Know when to call HR
onboarding.text: Every guide shows when to get HR involved. Add your HR contact in Settings for one-tap help.

onboardingNote: If you close SayWotNow, or your device closes it in the background, anything you've typed is lost. That's deliberate.

disclaimer.title: Before you start
disclaimer.text: SayWotNow provides general guidance to help managers prepare for and hold workplace conversations. It is based on UK employment practice and is not legal advice. Your organisation's own policies always take priority. Laws and best practice change, and every situation is different, so if you're unsure, or if a guide suggests it, speak to your HR team or a qualified adviser before acting. The app's creators accept no liability for decisions made using this guidance.

privacy.title: Privacy statement
text: SayWotNow does not collect, store or share any personal data. Everything you type into a template is held only while you're using it and is cleared when you send, discard or close it.
Summaries are sent using your device's own email app, so they're handled by your email provider, not by us.
The app does not connect to the internet once it's installed, and contains no analytics, advertising or tracking.
The only things saved on your device are your preferences (such as favourites and your HR team's contact details), and these never leave your device.

about.title: About SayWotNow
text: SayWotNow is the support every line manager wishes they had.
Run better 1:1s – fill in a structured template and email the summary in seconds.
Prepare for tough conversations – step-by-step guides for 15 situations, from lateness to mental health to pay rise requests.
Know when to call HR – every guide flags when to get advice.
Handy tools – holiday and notice calculators, the Bradford Factor, a feedback builder and more.
Private by design: SayWotNow never stores what you type. Your notes leave the app only through your own email.
Guidance is based on UK employment practice and isn't legal advice.

contentInfo.title: Content information
contentInfo.text: Guides and templates reflect UK employment practice as at November 2026. They are draft content and will be reviewed by a qualified HR professional or employment lawyer before release.
